mapper.sql: select outtaskitemid, outtaskid, outbillid, outorderid, hintsite, hintbatchno, sn, hintqty, outdesc, dataversion, data1, data2, data3, data4, data5, data6, data7, data8, materialid, collectedqty, collecter, outstate, collect_date, repertoryid, occupyqty, occupyflag, subinventory_code, hintfinish, palletno, productline, workstation, agvstate, beatflag from outtaskitem
mapper.insert:
insert into outtaskitem
outtaskid, outbillid, outorderid, hintsite, hintbatchno, sn, hintqty, outdesc, dataversion, data1, data2, data3, data4, data5, data6, data7, data8, materialid, collectedqty, collecter, outstate, collect_date, repertoryid, occupyqty, occupyflag, subinventory_code, hintfinish, palletno, productline, workstation, agvstate, beatflag,
#{outtaskid}, #{outbillid}, #{outorderid}, #{hintsite}, #{hintbatchno}, #{sn}, #{hintqty}, #{outdesc}, #{dataversion}, #{data1}, #{data2}, #{data3}, #{data4}, #{data5}, #{data6}, #{data7}, #{data8}, #{materialid}, #{collectedqty}, #{collecter}, #{outstate}, #{collectDate}, #{repertoryid}, #{occupyqty}, #{occupyflag}, #{subinventoryCode}, #{hintfinish}, #{palletno}, #{productline}, #{workstation}, #{agvstate}, #{beatflag},
mapper.delete:
delete from outtaskitem where outtaskitemid in
#{outtaskitemid}
mapper.select:
select d1.* from ( select b.taskcomment, nvl(c.storeroomno,' ') as storeroomno, nvl(op.orderno,' ') as orderno, nvl(op.po_number,' ') as po_number, b.forcesite, b.forcebatch, b.outtaskno, d.storesiteno, f.matcode, f.matname, a.palletno, nvl(b.outdesc,' ') as outdesc, b.outtaskid, e.operation, e.userid, nvl(a.outstate,0) as outstate, nvl(b.collecter,0) as collecter, nvl(a.collecter,0) as i_collecter, nvl(b.collecter,0) as t_collecter, b.outdate, c.roomtag, a.hintqty, a.collectedqty, a.outtaskitemid, nvl(op.wip_supplement_flag,'N') as wip_supplement_flag, nvl(g.schedule_group_name,'') as schedule_group_name, nvl(g.workstation,'N') as workstation, nvl(op.transfertype,'0') as transfertype, nvl(b.batchflag,0) as batchflag, g.delivery_data, g.delivery_time, b.beatflag, a.subinventory_code from outtaskitem a, outtask b, storeroom c, storesite d, pda_user_storeroomno e, pm_material f, outbill g, outproof op where a.outtaskid = b.outtaskid and a.outbillid = g.outbillid and a.hintsite = d.storesiteid and a.materialid = f.pm_materialid and b.storeroomid = c.storeroomid and c.storeroomno = e.operation and g.outproofid = op.outproofid and b.tasksource = op.outproofid and nvl(a.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(a.hintqty,0) - nvl(a.collectedqty,0) > 0
and a.outtaskid=#{outtaskid} and nvl(b.beatflag,'N')=#{beatflag} and NVL(b.batchflag,0) = #{batchflag} and nvl(a.collecter,0) = #{i_collecter} and nvl(a.outstate,0) = #{outstate} and e.userid = #{userId} and b.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{taskcomment}),'%') and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} and b.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} and c.roomtag = #{roomTag} and nvl(op.transfertype,'0') = #{transferType} )d1 where 1=1
and ( d1.matcode like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or d1.storesiteno like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') )
order by d1.outdate desc,d1.taskcomment desc , d1.orderno desc,d1.storesiteno asc,d1.matcode asc order by d1.${sortColumn} ${sortType}

select d1.* from ( select b.taskcomment, nvl(c.storeroomno,' ') as storeroomno, nvl(op.orderno,' ') as orderno, nvl(op.po_number,' ') as po_number, b.forcesite, b.forcebatch, b.outtaskno, d.storesiteno, f.matcode, f.matname, a.palletno, nvl(b.outdesc,' ') as outdesc, b.outtaskid, e.operation, e.userid, nvl(a.outstate,0) as outstate, nvl(b.collecter,0) as collecter, nvl(a.collecter,0) as i_collecter, nvl(b.collecter,0) as t_collecter, b.outdate, c.roomtag, a.hintqty, a.collectedqty, a.outtaskitemid, nvl(op.wip_supplement_flag,'N') as wip_supplement_flag, nvl(g.schedule_group_name,'') as schedule_group_name, nvl(g.workstation,'N') as workstation, nvl(op.transfertype,'0') as transfertype, nvl(b.batchflag,0) as batchflag, g.delivery_data, g.delivery_time, b.beatflag, a.subinventory_code from outtaskitem a, outtask b, storeroom c, storesite d, pda_user_storeroomno e, pm_material f, outbill g, outproof op where a.outtaskid = b.outtaskid and a.outbillid = g.outbillid and a.hintsite = d.storesiteid and a.materialid = f.pm_materialid and b.storeroomid = c.storeroomid and c.storeroomno = e.operation and g.outproofid = op.outproofid and b.tasksource = op.outproofid and nvl(a.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(a.hintqty,0) - nvl(a.collectedqty,0) > 0
and a.outtaskid=#{outtaskid} and nvl(b.beatflag,'N')=#{beatflag} and NVL(b.batchflag,0) = #{batchflag} and nvl(a.collecter,0) = #{i_collecter} and nvl(a.outstate,0) = #{outstate} and e.userid = #{userId} and b.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{taskcomment}),'%') and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} and b.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} and c.roomtag = #{roomTag} and nvl(op.transfertype,'0') = #{transferType} )d1 where 1=1
and ( d1.matcode like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or d1.storesiteno like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') )
order by d1.outdate desc,d1.taskcomment desc , d1.orderno desc,d1.storesiteno asc,d1.matcode asc order by d1.${sortColumn} ${sortType}

select pm.matcode, sts.storesiteno, oi.hintqty, oi.collectedqty , oi.hintbatchno, oi.sn, str.storeroomno, oi.outtaskitemid, oi.subinventory_code, pm.matname, oi.palletno, onf.orderno, GetRepQtyByOutTaskItemId(oi.repertoryid,oi.materialid,oi.outtaskitemid) as repqty, GetPalletStatusByOutTaskItemId(oi.outtaskid,oi.palletno) as palletStatus, pm.matinnercode, row_number() over(order by sts.storesiteno,pm.matcode,oi.outtaskitemid) as data1 from outtask o, outtaskitem oi, pm_material pm, storeroom str, storesite sts, outbill g, outproof onf where o.outtaskid=oi.outtaskid and oi.materialid=pm.pm_materialid and o.storeroomid = str.storeroomid and oi.hintsite = sts.storesiteid and oi.outstate = 1 and oi.outbillid = g.outbillid and g.OUTPROOFID = onf.OUTPROOFID and nvl(oi.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0 and (nvl(oi.hintqty,0)-nvl(oi.collectedqty,0))> 0 and o.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} and str.roomtag = #{roomTag} and oi.collecter = #{collecter} and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} order by sts.storesiteno,pm.matcode,oi.outtaskitemid

select pm.matcode, sts.storesiteno, oi.hintqty, oi.collectedqty , oi.hintbatchno, oi.sn, str.storeroomno, oi.outtaskitemid, oi.subinventory_code, pm.matname, oi.palletno, onf.orderno, GetRepQtyByOutTaskItemId(oi.repertoryid,oi.materialid,oi.outtaskitemid) as repqty, GetPalletStatusByOutTaskItemId(oi.outtaskid,oi.palletno) as palletStatus, pm.matinnercode from outtask o, outtaskitem oi, pm_material pm, storeroom str, storesite sts, outbill g, outproof onf where o.outtaskid=oi.outtaskid and oi.materialid=pm.pm_materialid and o.storeroomid = str.storeroomid and oi.hintsite = sts.storesiteid and oi.outstate = 1 and oi.outbillid = g.outbillid and g.OUTPROOFID = onf.OUTPROOFID and nvl(oi.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0 and o.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} and str.roomtag = #{roomTag} and oi.collecter = #{collecter} and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} order by sts.storesiteno,pm.matcode

select d1.* from ( select distinct b.taskcomment, nvl(op.orderno,' ') as orderno, nvl(op.po_number,' ') as po_number, a.palletno, b.outtaskno, d.storesiteno, b.outtaskid
from outtaskitem a, outtask b, storeroom c, storesite d, pda_user_storeroomno e, pm_material f, outbill g, outproof op where a.outtaskid = b.outtaskid and a.outbillid = g.outbillid and a.hintsite = d.storesiteid and a.materialid = f.pm_materialid and b.storeroomid = c.storeroomid and c.storeroomno = e.operation and g.outproofid = op.outproofid and b.tasksource = op.outproofid and nvl(a.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(a.hintqty,0) - nvl(a.collectedqty,0) > 0
and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} and c.roomtag = #{roomTag} and b.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{taskcomment}),'%') and e.userid = #{userId} and nvl(a.outstate,0) = #{outstate} and nvl(a.collecter,0) = #{i_collecter} and a.outtaskid=#{outtaskid} and b.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} )d1 where 1=1 order by d1.palletno asc
where COLLECTEDQTY != 0 and outtaskid = #{outtaskid} and PALLETNO = #{palletno}
where hintsite = #{hintsite} and materialid = #{materialid} and COLLECTEDQTY = 0 and rownum < 2
